title: Inspect and extend: Connect channels, messages, and profile UI
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx` to demonstrate and safely improve tab shell, selected channel, offline banner, reconnect control, shared components, and status rendering.
problem: A user journey crosses several screens and one shared provider. Follow a selected channel into message filtering and check how offline errors appear to the learner. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx` and the related project files: App.tsx; src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx; src/screens/ChannelsScreen.tsx; src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx; src/components.tsx; src/theme.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to tab shell, selected channel, offline banner, reconnect control, shared components, and status rendering.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The app has no login, push notification integration, or upstream client parity.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A user journey crosses several screens and one shared provider. Follow a selected channel into message filtering and check how offline errors appear to the learner.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Search for `export default function ChatScreen` first.
Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
